# Test-track data

Generated truth and observation sets from the test-track suite
([`docs/test-tracks/`](../../docs/test-tracks/README.md)). The format is
`docs/test-tracks/data-format.md`.

- `samples/` holds one small, committed set per scenario (TT-01 to TT-10), 6.5 MB
  in total. They are regenerated by `python docs/test-tracks/tools/gen_tracks.py`
  and validated by `python docs/test-tracks/tools/validate_tracks.py`; every one
  replays through the ingest gateway without a quarantine in
  `gungnir-ingest/tests/test_track_samples.rs`.
- `full/` holds full-size sets generated on demand
  (`gen_tracks.py --full TT-01`). It is ignored by version control; the seed and
  input versions in each set's `metadata.json` make it reproducible instead.

Each set contains `metadata.json` (scenario, seed, input versions, counts,
provenance, validation result), `truth.jsonl` (per entity per tick, with class and
side labels), `detections.jsonl` (one `DetectionView` per line, the recorded-feed
format), `detections-truth.jsonl` (which entity caused each detection line, or none
for a false alarm), `sensors.json`, `events.jsonl`, `validation-report.json`, and the two
re-observation sidecars a laydown rehearsal reads, `entities.json` and `environment.json`
(`data-format.md` §10). `sensor-models.json` beside `samples/` is the JSON export of the
sensor catalogue a rehearsal resolves a deployment sensor's detection model from (§11).

Everything here is synthetic, generated on the fictional Vell estuary of
`docs/mission/vignettes.md`; no real site, route, unit, or platform identity
appears.
